**Question:** What were Starbucks' global comparable store sales and total net revenues for its fiscal Q4 2026?
*As of 2026-10-03*

**Interpreted as:** Starbucks' fiscal Q4 2026 (2026-06-29 to 2026-09-27) has ended but is not yet reported, so per the fallback rule the plan covers the latest reported quarter instead: Q3 FY2026 (2026-03-30 to 2026-06-28). Fiscal year ends late September, so fiscal Q4 2026 is not calendar Q4; the question's 'fiscal Q4 2026' was read as the company's own Q4 FY2026 label. 'Global comparable store sales' read as the company's reported consolidated comparable store sales growth (including the North America and International segment comps it discloses). 'Total net revenues' read as the GAAP total net revenues line in the consolidated statements of earnings.

| | Global comparable store sales growth (%) | Total net revenues (GAAP, USD millions) |
|---|---|---|
| Starbucks — Q3 FY2026 (13-week quarter ended June 28, 2026) | 7.9% [1][2] | $9,322.7 [3] |

- Starbucks' fiscal Q4 2026 (2026-06-29 to 2026-09-27) had ended but was not yet reported as of 2026-10-03, so its global comparable store sales and total net revenues cannot be stated; the latest reported quarter is Q3 FY2026 (13-week quarter ended June 28, 2026). [1]
- For Q3 FY2026 (quarter ended June 28, 2026), Starbucks reported consolidated net revenues decreased 1% to $9.3 billion, including on a constant currency basis, reflecting the Starbucks China transaction. [1]
- The GAAP total net revenues line in the consolidated statements of earnings for Q3 FY2026 (quarter ended June 28, 2026) was $9,322.7 million, versus $9,456.0 million in the quarter ended June 29, 2025. [3]
- The Q3 FY2026 global comparable store sales increase of 7.9% was driven by a 4.2% increase in comparable transactions and a 3.5% increase in average ticket, with North America comps up 8.1% and International comps up 5.7%. [1]
- As guidance issued with the Q3 FY2026 release, Starbucks said it expects fourth quarter U.S. comparable store sales growth of 6.5% or greater, leading to full fiscal year 2026 global comparable store sales growth nearing 6.0% and consolidated net revenues flat to slight growth year over year; no Q4 FY2026 global comparable store sales or revenue figure was given. [1]

- Starbucks global comparable store sales for fiscal Q4 2026 (2026-06-29 to 2026-09-27): Q4 FY2026 ended 2026-09-27 but no earnings release or 10-K for the quarter exists as of 2026-10-03; the company gave only Q4 U.S. comp guidance (6.5% or greater), not a Q4 global comps figure. [1]
- Starbucks total net revenues for fiscal Q4 2026 (2026-06-29 to 2026-09-27): Q4 FY2026 results were not yet reported as of 2026-10-03; the release provides only full fiscal year 2026 consolidated net revenue guidance of flat to slight growth year over year. [1]
